decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The erection of a rear roof extension with two roof windows to front of the house, as shown on drawing numbers, AG-04-003 (Rev D), received 27th October 2006, would by reason of their size, position and appearance, not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof.
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with two roof windows to front of the house
